name: tedtoolkit-career
description: Candidate career evidence, target research, resumes, matching, and interview preparation.

interface.shortDescription: Maintain career evidence and create job materials
interface.longDescription: Factual, evidence-led candidate workflows for maintaining one career workspace, researching companies and roles, matching evidence, writing and reviewing targeted resumes, and preparing for interviews.
defaultPrompt: Maintain one factual local career workspace as the source for later career materials.
Research one company and role with dated sources before matching candidate evidence.
Write or review only a company-role-targeted resume artifact.
